description: This file contains functions related to configuring Lantiq-based systems, including detection of system type and setup procedures for DSL and ATM interfaces.

methods.name: lantiq_is_vdsl_system
methods.description: Detects if the system is a VDSL system based on CPU information.

methods.name: lantiq_setup_dsl_helper
methods.description: Sets up DSL and ATM interfaces based on system type and presence of modules.
